# @JoeOfSomeTrades

> Personal portfolio for @JoeOfSomeTrades, a music, audio, and game design
> enthusiast. The site is one arcade-themed page with three views and two live
> projects.

The site is static. It holds no login and no paywall. Each view has its own hash
URL, so the page never reloads on navigation.

## Views

- [Who Am I](https://portfolio.joeofsometrades.workers.dev/#whoami): A short introduction.
- [Links](https://portfolio.joeofsometrades.workers.dev/#links): Contact and social links.
- [Projects](https://portfolio.joeofsometrades.workers.dev/#projects): The project index.

## Projects

- [Maximum Slappage](https://portfolio.joeofsometrades.workers.dev/#radio): A Live365 radio station.
- [Smiles Sadistic Adventure](https://portfolio.joeofsometrades.workers.dev/#game): A browser game. The source lives at https://github.com/DecibillyJoel/Smiles-Sadistic-Adventure.
